contact.full_name: Senior Full Stack Engineer • Angular & React Specialist • AI Driven Engineer

data.summary:
AI-driven Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of expertise developing and delivering enterprise-grade Angular and React applications across healthcare, HR-tech, IoT, and EV sectors. Proven ability to lead frontend initiatives, engineer performant SPAs, and integrate AI-powered capabilities including LLM-driven chatbots, RAG pipelines using ChromaDB and LangChain, and agentic workflows. Combines deep frontend mastery — Angular standalone components, RxJS, NgRx,Performance Optimization Technics, React (Vite + TypeScript) — with full-stack proficiency in Node.js, Supabase PostgreSQL,SQL, and RESTful API design. Sole architect of a production AI chatbot platform (FastAPI · LiteLLM · LangChain · ChromaDB · React) with Minimax AI game engine integration, demonstrating applied AI engineering depth rare among frontend specialists. Adept at translating complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable architectures while mentoring teams, driving Agile delivery, and leveraging cutting-edge AI tooling (OpenAI, LiteLLM, MCP, N8N) to accelerate product development and deliver measurable business outcomes.
CORE COMPETENCIES & TECHNICAL SKILLS
Frontend
Angular (2–18) · React.js · TypeScript · JavaScript (ES2022) · HTML5 · CSS3 · SCSS · RxJS · NgRx
UI Frameworks
Angular Material · PrimeNG · PrimeReact · Syncfusion · Kendo UI · Tailwind CSS · Bootstrap · Ngx-Bootstrap
Backend & APIs
Node.js · Express.js · FastAPI (Python) · RESTful APIs · API Contract Design · SQLAlchemy · Alembic · Supabase · PostgreSQL · SQL
AI & Automation
OpenAI APIs · LangChain · LiteLLM · RAG Pipelines · ChromaDB · Vector Embeddings · LLM Integration · MCP · N8N Automation · GitHub Copilot · Prompt Engineering · Conversation Memory
Testing & Quality
Jest · Karma · Jasmine · Unit Testing · Code Reviews · Debugging
DevOps & Tools
Git · Jenkins · CI/CD Pipelines · Jira · Agile/SCRUM · Webpack · Lazy Loading · Code Splitting · AWS (S3 Storage, EC2 Application Deployments)
Integrations
Stripe Payments · Google APIs · OpenTok · PubNub · SuperSet · Apache Superset,AM Charts
Soft Skills
Frontend Architecture · Technical Leadership · Cross-functional Collaboration · Mentoring · Problem Solving
